scope: Current tracked source tree only; Git history and release dependency closures are audited separately.

provenance.description: Small synthetic bytes authored directly in parser, transport, avatar, and UI tests; they are not copied from an external media asset.
provenance.toolchain: The Rust, Node, Playwright, or Flutter test harness named by each source path
provenance.recipe: Literal one-pixel, short-text, minimal PNG, or minimal SVG fixture bytes encoded directly beside their assertions.

provenance.description: Small clock SVG authored inline for the Apache-2.0 countdown-bot example.
Deterministic one-pixel raster fixture generated locally for source-level image transport and UI tests; no external media input is used.
provenance.recipe: Programmatic 1x1 opaque teal RGBA PNG assembled from fixed PNG chunks and an uncompressed DEFLATE block; no external media input.

provenance.description: The Carryforth mark was created in the named Carryforth commit; the Admin and Web files are byte-identical source-tree copies of that project artwork.
Carryforth wordmark project artwork. Font-family values are rendering preferences; the SVG embeds no font bytes.
Platform renditions of Carryforth's canonical source SVG. The current ICNS container is provenance-bound but is not falsely claimed to be byte-reproducible with the current Tauri encoder.
Deterministic Android and iOS renditions generated from Carryforth's canonical source SVG.
provenance.recipe: Render the canonical 1024 SVG at the manifest-declared Android and iOS dimensions, then verify every output hash.

provenance.description: Original fixed-point PCM notification tones and PCM-derived SVG waveforms. The generator reads no legacy audio, sample pack, network resource, or system font.
provenance.recipe: Generate mono 48 kHz 16-bit little-endian PCM with fixed integer parameters and derive each waveform SVG from those samples.

provenance.description: Project texture produced from an in-repository procedural SVG recipe. It is provenance-bound to the current bytes without claiming cross-browser screenshot reproducibility.
Byte-identical animation frames and sound from the immutable EmergeTools/Pow source revision; its MIT license is stored beside the media.
Inter Variable 4.001 font files (embedded name-table source revision git-9221beed3, resolved to the immutable upstream commit below) with the complete OFL-1.1 text stored alongside them.
Synthetic lossless WebP upload fixture generated from a fixed 2x2 red/green pixel grid without external media input.
provenance.toolchain: Rust 1.95.0 with image 0.25.10 pinned by Cargo.lock
provenance.recipe: Encode a fixed 2x2 RGB pixel grid (red, red, green, green) with the pinned lossless WebP encoder.

provenance.description: Synthetic 3x2 color grids generated by the tracked Android API 36 Bitmap recipe, sanitized by the product pipeline, and checked against exact duplicate-copy contracts.

provenance.toolchain: Android 16 API 36 Bitmap.compress plus the tracked Carryforth sanitizer
provenance.recipe: Programmatic red/green/blue/alpha pixel grids; no external image input.

provenance.description: Synthetic 2x2 color grid with tracked source bytes, UIKit encoding recipe, sanitizer derivatives, and exact cross-tree copy contracts.

provenance.recipe: Programmatic 2x2 red/green source grid; no external image input.
